decisions.scenario: Switching from unavailable Russian food to an expensive British restaurant

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for an expensive restaurant that serves Russian food.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are no expensive restaurants serving Russian food. Can I help you find another type of food?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes. Do you have British food?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes, there are six options. Does the part of town matter?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I can recommend Graffiti in the west. Would you like more information?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: May I have the phone number?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Their phone number is 01223 277977. Is there anything else I can help you with?
